title: Front Desk Volunteer
hours_note: One four-hour shift per week (Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM), minimum six month commitment
schedule_flexibility: Front desk shifts Monday-Friday 9am-5pm; support visitors, staff, and patrons in person and on the phone
description: Greet visitors, answer phones, help with paperwork, organize resources, and provide general assistance at the Literacy Connects Library and community centers.
requirements: Minimum age 18 or older; live in Tucson area; pass background check; complete provided training; minimum six month commitment; 4 hours per week

title: Library Volunteer
hours_note: One four-hour shift per week (Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM), minimum one year commitment
description: Assist patrons with finding books, distribute free books and resources, support children's reading programs, and help with library operations.
requirements: Minimum age 18 or older; live in Tucson; background check; orientation/training; minimum one year commitment; 4 hours per week

title: Volunteer - Casa de los Niños
hours_note: Three hours per week (one day a week for a 3-hour shift), minimum six month commitment
schedule_flexibility: Choose between morning (7am-12pm), afternoon (12pm-5pm), or evening (5pm-8pm) shifts; one day per week
description: Support children and families in Tucson through child welfare, education, behavioral health, foster care placement, and community outreach; provide daily visits and activities.
requirements: Age 55+, live in Tucson; background check; training provided; income eligibility; 3 hours per week, 6 months commitment

title: Samaritans Crisis Line Volunteer
hours_note: One four-hour shift every week plus one overnight shift per month; full 200-hour commitment over nine months
schedule_flexibility: Remote call-taking from home, any time zone; 4-hour weekly shift + optional overnight shift per month
description: Answer and respond to 24/7 crisis calls and texts via text and phone for people in crisis. Volunteers work remotely from their homes, no appointments required.
requirements: Based anywhere in the US; able to access private space and technology for remote call-taking; serve at least one 2.5 or 5-hour shift each week; complete 40-hour training; 200 hours total over 9 months
contact: 41 West St, Boston, MA 02111 (nationally available); remote from home

title: The Trevor Project Crisis Counselor
hours_note: One 3-hour shift per week after completing 40-hour training over 8 weeks; 1-year minimum commitment
schedule_flexibility: Remote, 24/7 crisis services; 3-hour shifts aligned with student needs, placed on team
description: LGBTQ+ youth suicide prevention hotline. Volunteer counselors work remotely from home, 24/7, answering crisis calls and providing peer support.
requirements: 18+, US resident; private space/technology for remote call-taking; 3-hour shifts once per week; complete 40-hour training over 8 weeks; 1-year commitment
